{{Quote|On Soruus the Despot towers over the arena where many a gladiator has bled out his dreams. He holds a heatbeam in one great fist, but the statue is polysteel, assembled by a factory on Centares during the chancellorship of Kirbat the Unready. So I am told with sour reluctance by a tour guide who wishes to quiet me, not knowing he has succeeded all too well by revealing that my quest is not over.|[[Bleys Harand]], ''[[Travels Amid Strange Stars]]''|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
An '''individual''' at one point worked as a tour guide on the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Soruus]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />
